reviewNotes: Held back: the bar lines are read off the rhythm (CCEH's Noteworthy score could not be read); check the pickup against the score. Imported from CCEH tune 000630 (the melody read from 000630a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 21); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Johann M. Spiess has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1745, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). William Henry Havergal's dates (1793–1870) are from our page for the tune EVAN (content/hymns/tunes/evan.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1847.
